component.name: Cygnus
component.summary: Install and manage applications on the drive you choose

description.p: Cygnus installs AppImages, Flatpak bundles and Arch packages, and lets you choose which drive each application lives on. It checks that applications and the components they need are working, explains what is wrong when they are not, and offers safe fixes.

ul.li: Keeps large applications on a second drive, with menu entries that keep working when it is unplugged
Verifies downloads and vendor signatures before anything is installed
Every change is journaled and can be finished or undone after an interruption
Administrator rights only for the exact change you approved

description.p: First public beta. It has not had an independent security review; see the project page for what it can and cannot do.
